title: Kirby Problem 1.31
exact_target: Compute all graded homology groups, including integral torsion, for every torus knot in the Khovanov and general linear Khovanov--Rozansky theories.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2690 (KP-1.31). CC BY 4.0.
